verdict.rationale: turbopuffer documents its own filtering: vector search "combined with any filters," kNN over a filtered subset, regex matching, patch/delete by filter, and filterable attributes. Filtering on per-document `group_ids` at query time implies array-membership filtering. However, the evidence never shows the specific operator set the story asks for. Missing for 10: documented range operators, geo filtering, nested AND/OR/NOT boolean composition, explicit array-membership operators, and hands-on corroboration of filter expressiveness.
